description: This file defines the DestroyPurgeStrategy class, which extends PurgeStrategy and implements a purge method for deleting entity records related to an employee number within the OrangeHRM Maintenance plugin.

classes.name: DestroyPurgeStrategy
classes.description: A class implementing a specific purge strategy for deleting entities associated with an employee number in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Deletes entity records matching a specific employee number by removing them through the entity manager.
